concerns.text: FR‑012 requires two distinct behaviors: (a) for new inference inputs the system must log a warning and **skip** the molecule; (b) during test‑set evaluation the molecule is retained and a summary is logged. The plan’s Interpretability phase (Phase 6) only logs a warning and **processes** unseen atom/bond types (zero‑vector encoding) but never skips them, thus omitting branch (a) of FR‑012.

FR‑013 mandates that if the scaffold‑based test set contains fewer than 20 molecules the pipeline must **log a warning only** and **must not alter** the 80/10/10 split. The plan instead automatically re‑balances the split to 70/15/15 when the test set falls below 40 molecules, violating the ‘no‑rebalancing’ clause of FR‑013.
